Sort these strings in ascending order of length, and then concatenate them in that order to form a single string, concatenating without any separators, spaces, or newlines between the original strings. Input The input is given from Standard Input in the following format: N S_1 S_2 \vdots S_N Output Print the answer. Constraints - 2 \leq N \leq 50 - N is an integer. - Each S_i is a string consisting of lowercase English letters with length between 1 and 50, inclusive. - If i \neq j, the length of S_i is different from the length of S_j.
